faqs.question: How Does it Work?
faqs.answer:
Renting a Photobooth Has Never Been Easier!

Getting your photobooth is as simple as 1-2-3:

  1. Choose your booth options.
  2. Pick your event date.
  3. Place your order!

Your photobooth will arrive a few days before your event, ready for effortless setup. No tools required, and setup takes less than 10 minutes. Clear instructions are included, and our friendly phone support team is just a call away if you need assistance.

Enjoy the photobooth until the day after your event. When you're done, pack it up, attach the provided return label, and drop it off at your nearest UPS location.

It's convenience and fun—delivered right to your door!

faqs.question: What is the cancellation Policy?
faqs.answer:
Event Cancellation Policy:

  • Cancellations made more than 7 days prior to the event are eligible for a full refund.
  • Cancellations made within 7 days of the event will incur a $50 cancellation fee.

faqs.question: When do I return the equipment?
faqs.answer:
Return Policy

The photo booth must be returned on the first business day following your event:

  • For weekend events, this is typically Monday, unless it coincides with a UPS-recognized holiday, in which case the return will be due the next business day.
  • For weekday events, the return is due on the following business day.

A late fee of $100 per day, per item may apply if the photo booth or DJ equipment is not returned on time, unless prior arrangements have been made with us.

faqs.question: What if I have a problem?
faqs.answer:
Reliable and Supported 

Our iPad-based photobooth is built for reliability, so issues are uncommon. However, if you ever need assistance, our dedicated support team is just a call away. Contact us anytime at 1 (909) 403-7143—we’re here to help!

faqs.question: How do my guest received the Photos
faqs.answer:
Multiple Ways to Access and Share Photos

We offer several convenient options for your guests to access their photos:

  • Text or Email: Guests can send their photos directly to their phones or inboxes right from the booth.
  • On-the-Spot Printing: Choose our print option, and guests can take home a memorable keepsake with instant photo prints.

Whatever you choose, we make it easy to share the fun!

faqs.question: Do I need a WIFI or Hotspot?
faqs.answer:
WiFi Requirement

Our booth requires a WiFi connection to send texts and emails. If WiFi isn’t available at your event location, we’ve got you covered! You can add our hotspot option for just $40, which uses cellular networks to keep your booth connected.

steps.title: Convenient Doorstep Delivery
steps.text: Your photo booth will arrive 1-2 days before your event for easy setup. For a Saturday event, delivery is Thursday/Friday. Free shipping is included with all rentals. We'll handle packing and shipping the booth directly to your event location - no extra fees

steps.title: Quick 5-Minutes Assembly
steps.text: Our photo booth is designed for quick, easy setup with no tools or experience required. The booth can be fully assembled in minutes thanks to its intuitive snap-together design. Simply follow the instructions to get the booth up and running in no time.

steps.title: Quick and Easy Booth Pickup
steps.text: Returning your photo booth after your event couldn't be easier. We provide a UPS shipping label so you can pack up the booth and schedule a free pickup when your event wraps up. There are no extra rental fees or costs associated with returns.
